animal_behaviour.description: Social mob crepuscular/nocturnal grazing on native tussock and kangaroo grasses using pentapedal progression
High-speed bipedal hopping escape coupled with double hind-foot ground alarm thump
Evaporative cooling via licking superficial ventral forearm capillary network

animal_interaction.description: Native grass-layer grazer shaping herbaceous swards in SE Australian grassy box-gum and floodplain woodlands

animal_process.description: Elastic strain energy storage U = 0.5 * k * dL^2 in gastrocnemius & plantaris tendons
Conveyor-like anterior replacement of silica-abraded molars

animal_relation.description: ro:0002470 grazing on Poa labillardierei, Themeda triandra, and Microlaena stipoides
ro:0002303 grassy woodlands & open forests (Eucalyptus melliodora / E. camaldulensis)

animal_state.description: Healthy gait and joint angles within ROM bounds

component.description: cranial_and_facial_system (UBERON:0000975, finely haired rhinarium UBERON:0001756, tall cupped pinnae UBERON:0001757)
bipedal_saltatorial_axial_and_pelvic_system (UBERON:0001130, epipubic UBERON:0003661, forward marsupium UBERON:0001831, tail UBERON:0002415)
forelimb_and_elastic_tendon_hindlimb_system (UBERON:0002102, UBERON:0002103, Achilles/plantaris spring, syndactylous pes UBERON:0002389, digit IV & V)
osteology_myology_and_pelage (UBERON:0001434, UBERON:0001630, UBERON:0002199, dentition I 3/1 C 0/0 PM 1/1 M 4/4, silver-grey woolly pelage)

graph_partition.description: Sealed taxon, UBERON anatomy, ROM, allometry, InstanceState64, trophic & Country graph (553 quins)
Sealed DCAT package distribution manifest (76 quins)

life_stage.description: adult_doe (0.65-1.00, 24-38 kg, 1.30-1.60 m erect, forward-opening marsupium)
alpha_boomer_buck (0.65-1.00, 66-85 kg, up to 2.10 m erect, hypertrophied pectoral/forelimb musculature)

locomotor_mode.description: Slow pentapedal grazing progression (0.4-1.2 m/s, forelimbs + massive tail supporting weight while hindlimbs swing)
Bipedal elastic-recoil hop (5.0-17.5 m/s, >=54% Achilles/plantaris tendon strain recovery, tail counter-torque)
Upright bipedal alert sentinel stance (weight over pes digit IV & V and tail base)

profile.description: Photorealistic anatomical natural history film representation (pending ECO-WP-11B)
Real-time PBR open-world game representation (pending ECO-WP-11B)

query_case.description: SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } on dist/taxon.q42 (553 bindings verified)
SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } on dist/index.q42 (76 bindings verified)

relation_family.description: OBO Relation Ontology trophic grazing (ro:0002470 / rorel:trophically_interacts_with)
Local Contexts TK/BC custodial_country across 12 SE Australian First Nations Countries under SPC

source.description: Australian Faunal Directory (AFD) — Macropus giganteus Shaw, 1790
Atlas of Living Australia (ALA) species profile & 251k+ occurrence records
Australian Museum Eastern Grey Kangaroo diagnostic profile (finely haired rhinarium, silver-grey coat, size)
NSW Environment Kangaroos & Wallabies profile + NSW BioNet Atlas

trait.description: Finely haired rhinarium between nostrils with narrow bare black rim (separates M. giganteus from O. rufus & M. fuliginosus)
Grazing diprotodont dentition I 3/1 C 0/0 PM 1/1 M 4/4 with forward-progressing molar progression
Gastrocnemius & plantaris elastic tendons (k ~ 62,000 N/m, max strain 7.8%)
Dense superficial ventral forearm vascular plexus cooled by saliva licking

variant.description: InstanceState64 alpha_boomer_buck variant (up to 2.1 m / 66-85 kg)

subject_identifier.description: NCBI Taxonomy TaxID 9317 (M. g. giganteus TaxID 39422)
